title: Romanian minister says he believes the ANCPI cyberattack was ransomware
date_note: Digi24 interview published 24 November; the article dates the attack itself to 15 July, so this records the minister's statement.
summary: In an interview with Digi24, Romania's Minister Delegate for Digitalization Bogdan Dumitru said he believes the attack on the cadastre agency ANCPI was "un atac clasic de tip... ransomware" and that "datele au fost criptate". Digi24 says the attack hit on 15 July and names the e-Terra application. The minister said he did not know the situation in detail.
plain: Romania's digitalization minister told Digi24 he believes the July attack on the cadastre agency ANCPI was ransomware that encrypted data. He said he did not know the details.
exec: A Romanian minister says he believes the July ANCPI attack was ransomware; he said he lacks detail.

validation.note: Only Digi24 read; no ANCPI own statement read.
